notes.title: ENKI Patch, Discount and Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/OmuF8iA.png?1[/img]

Hey, Imre from SOEDESCO here to bring you the latest update on ENKI

We've got a lot to announce, but first we would like to thank everyone who has played the game for their support. Your feedback has been invaluable in making ENKI a better game. After already implementing a much requested slider for the brightness in the game we have created a big optimization patch with a lot of tweaks and fixes to make sure that more systems are able to play ENKI. Players who are playing the game on the ‘low’ and ‘mid’ systems should see a big performance boost.

But we have done more than just fixes, ENKI now features Steam Trading Cards and there is a 25% week-long discount starting right now! So if you've been sitting on the fence and unsure whether or not to jump in, now is a great time to do so. Give it a try and earn Trading Cards while doing so!

We're thrilled by the feedback we've gotten so far, so keep sending us your thoughts on the experience. 

Best wishes from me, SOEDESCO & the team at STORM IN A TEACUP

notes.title: New Update with Gamma Correction!
notes.content:
New update is now live! We added a slider to change the Gamma Value of the screen. You can find this new option in the Pause Menu during the game.

Good game to everyone and Leave some feedbacks! ;)
